description: NYC Drinking Water Tank Inspections and Audits Compliance Results is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This is an official NYC Health Department dataset. The Health Department does not endorse datasets using these data that may be created by others. The dataset contains the drinking water tank oversight activity and compliance results for NYC buildings that have water tanks. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Health. Its tags are drinking water, audit, violation, inspection, water tank. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH). The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
